note: Reviewed adjudications for rows the gate cannot resolve from the data alone. Row numbers are valid only for the CSV named above. rationale: Image shows silver ballet-style pumps with a round toe and bow on a visible mid stiletto heel. The product name 'Ballet Heels' is accurate. Two enrichment runs disagreed (v2 read flats, full run read heels); the image settles it as heels. The live catalog currently files this under footwear/flats, which is wrong.

name: Kaleidoscope Floral Print Skirt
rationale: Image shows a white floral maxi skirt worn with a separate top and a visible waistband. The merchant subcategory column already said 'skirt' and the image agrees; only the product name said 'Dress'. Correcting the name makes the record coherent. The contradicted merchant description is suppressed because it describes a dress.

The merchant name and description both say navy. Enrichment read them as black, which dark navy suede photographs as under warm light.
